test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb, 2026 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: 7 women P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting in a row facing south (not necessarily in the same order). V is fifth to the left of P. No one is to the right of P. T is exactly in the middle of row. U is fourth to the right of V. Q is not to the right of V. S is to the immediate left of T. How many women are sitting between R and Q?
solution:
**Given: **7 women P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting in a row facing south (not necessarily in the same order). 

1. V is fifth to the left of P. 

2. No one is to the right of P. 

3. T is exactly in the middle of row. 

4. U is fourth to the right of V. </span&
